pois.name: Bellport Country Club & 18-Hole Golf Course
pois.desc: Village-owned 18-hole bayside golf course (137 acres, built 1899) & tennis complex with resident rates.

pois.name: Bellport Village Marina & Yacht Club
pois.desc: Resident boat slips, sailing pier, sunset promenade, and Bellport Bay Yacht Club.

pois.name: Whalehouse Point Ferry to Ho-Hum Beach
pois.desc: Residents-only passenger ferry across Great South Bay to Ho-Hum ocean beach on Fire Island.

pois.name: Bandshell Waterfront Park
pois.desc: Bayfront lawn and summer outdoor concert bandshell overlooking Great South Bay.

pois.name: Mothers’ Beach
pois.desc: Calm, shallow Bellport Bay sandy cove beach tucked along Historic Shore Road.

pois.name: Village Green & Osborn Park
pois.desc: Shaded central Village green, gazebo, and community park steps off Main Street.

pois.name: Post-Morrow Bayfront Preserve
pois.desc: Protected waterfront salt-marsh and bird sanctuary on Bellport Bay.

pois.name: Peat Hole Wetlands Preserve
pois.desc: 6.9-acre protected coastal woodland and kettle-pond preserve on the eastern Village edge.

pois.name: Bellport Village Hall & Community Center
pois.desc: Incorporated Village Hall (issue point for resident ferry IDs & Village Rental Licenses).

pois.name: Bellport-Brookhaven Historical Society
pois.desc: Campus of 19th-century historic museum buildings, barn museum, and gardens.

pois.name: South Country Library
pois.desc: Historic shingled community library just north of Main Street.

pois.name: The Gateway Playhouse
pois.desc: Historic professional musical theatre & performing arts campus (founded 1950).

pois.name: The Bellport Restaurant
pois.desc: Signature Main Street bistro known for coastal American fare, raw bar, and lively dining room.

pois.name: PORTERS on the Lane
pois.desc: Beloved neighborhood restaurant & bar with porch seating and fireplace on Bellport Lane.

pois.name: Peter’s on the Green
pois.desc: Clubhouse dining and brunch overlooking the fairways and Great South Bay.

pois.name: Cafe Castello
pois.desc: Classic Main Street Italian trattoria with sidewalk tables.

pois.name: Avino’s Italian Table
pois.desc: Long-running family Italian dinner spot on the west end of Village Main Street.

pois.name: Brewport Coffee House
pois.desc: Morning Village hub for espresso, pastries, and porch conversation.

pois.name: La Plage / Station Rd Bistro
pois.desc: Intimate French-inspired bistro just steps off the four corners.

pois.name: Uncle Joe’s Pizzeria
pois.desc: Casual post-beach Village slice shop and family pizzeria.

pois.name: Bellport General
pois.desc: Curated gourmet market, provisions, coffee, and prepared picnic fare for the Ho-Hum ferry.

pois.name: Copper Beech
pois.desc: Iconic home goods, garden, linen, and coastal entertaining emporium.

pois.name: Pamela Lerner Home & Design
pois.desc: Antiques, custom furniture, gifts, and classic Bellport interior design shop.

pois.name: Bellport Apothecary
pois.desc: Boutique apothecary, skincare, wellness, and espresso counter.

pois.name: Tola. & Gallery 125
pois.desc: Independent clothing boutique and contemporary art gallery on Main Street.

pois.name: Old Purchase Properties
pois.desc: Boutique historic Bellport Village real estate office.

pois.name: The Bellport Inn
pois.desc: Restored historic boutique inn & cottages in the heart of Main Street.
